text: Dear Alan. We need to talk about your router.
Jev made decision models the main character on tech Twitter.
Then Laya went open source. So we taught it to learn.
Meet Pennywise. An RL-trained router that picks the right model for every request.
Nine hundred forty-eight graded prompts. One very warm laptop.
Then we raced Alan's own Auto Router. Same ten tasks. Same tests.
Pennywise: eleven minutes. Auto Router: thirty-seven. Both, ten for ten.
The trick? When the fast model fumbles a tool call, it escalates. No drama.
Nine-page technical report. Confidence intervals included. Yes, we're those people.
Pennywise. Built for Alan's router. Your move, Alan.
